rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for physically steering or driving a vehicle.

example.english: I can steer, but I can't park.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik1 zaa1 ce1 daan6 m4 sik1 paak3 ce1

rows.note: Use this for guiding or influencing a person, group, or line of thought toward a course of action.

example.english: The manager used a few questions to steer everyone towards accepting this proposal.
example.traditional: 經理用幾個問題，引導大家接受呢個方案。
example.jyutping: ging1 lei5 jung6 gei2 go3 man6 tai4 jan5 dou6 daai6 gaa1 zip3 sau6 ni1 go3 fong1 on3

rows.note: Use this for saying that a vehicle responds easily and can be steered without difficulty.

example.english: The steering wheel on this car is light, so it’s really easy to steer.
example.traditional: 呢架車個軚盤好輕，真係好揸。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaa3 ce1 go3 taai5 pun4 hou2 heng1 zan1 hai6 hou2 zaa1
